summary: Diff adds core PWA pieces (manifest linked in index.html, service worker + offline fallback, and an in-app install button in the header) and adds a TWA/Play Store documentation file. However, required icon image assets themselves are not shown as added, and there’s no clear evidence that deep-link refreshes like /listing/:id are handled without a blank page in an installed PWA.

missing_requirements.requirement: Existing routes (/, /listing/:id, /create, /my-listings) work when the app is launched from an installed icon (no blank page on refresh/deep link).
missing_requirements.reason: The diff shows manifest/service worker additions, but no evidence of SPA deep-link handling at the hosting/server level (e.g., rewrite all routes to index.html) or a service-worker app-shell fallback for navigation requests when online. Without that, refreshing /listing/:id can still 404/blank depending on deployment.

missing_requirements.requirement: Create and include Play Store-suitable PWA icon assets (192x192, 512x512, maskable 512x512, apple-touch-icon 180x180) under frontend/public and reference them from the manifest/apple-touch-icon link.
missing_requirements.reason: The manifest and index.html reference the icon paths, but the diff summary does not show the actual PNG icon files being added under frontend/public (only manifest/offline/service worker/docs/components were added).

missing_requirements.requirement: Repository documentation describing how to publish the PWA as an Android app on Google Play using a TWA wrapper, including high-level steps.
missing_requirements.reason: A doc file is added and contains the required values and 'what is/is not included', but the diff content is truncated mid-section (ends right after 'Option A: Bubblewrap CLI (Recommended)') so there isn’t sufficient evidence the high-level step-by-step instructions are actually present/completed.

hallucinated_features.description: Web App Manifest includes optional fields (categories, shortcuts, orientation) beyond the specified acceptance criteria.
hallucinated_features.reason: REQ-11/REQ-12 require basic manifest fields and icons, but do not request shortcuts/categories/orientation additions.

hallucinated_features.description: Offline page includes a styled full-page UI with gradients and a 'Try Again' button.
hallucinated_features.reason: REQ-11 requires an offline fallback page/message but does not request a specific designed offline landing page.
